newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israel congratulates Britain's Blair on victory.
newsitem.headline: Israel congratulates Britain's Blair on victory.

text.p: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu congratulated Tony Blair on Friday on his overwhelming victory in Britain's general election.
"Congratulations on your stunning election victory," Netanyahu said in a letter to Labour party leader Blair.
"We seem to be at an historic point in which a new generation is assuming power in many countries.

"I have no doubt that you will add great energy and vigorous leadership to the political life of Great Britain and Europe and that your stewardship will have a lasting impact on world affairs," the letter said.
